next: **[infra] `command_run.py`'s SHARED close path still makes two bare git calls with no scrubbed environment (2026-09-18)** — T01b closed the class inside the `/fabrik-task` lane (`_repo_root` and `_task_git` both take `_scrubbed_git_env()`), but `git status --porcelain` and `git log -m` on the general close path — the one EVERY command takes — remain bare `subprocess.run(["git", …])`. An inherited `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE` points their advisory at a repository the close never named. NOT fixed in T01b on purpose: those calls are pre-existing and shared, and T01b's whole acceptance rests on byte-identity for every other command, so changing a shared-path subprocess is exactly what that invariant forbids doing casually. The fix is one argument each plus a byte-identity re-verification, and it belongs to whoever next owns that path. Medium — the same class as the T01b defect, at lower severity (an advisory, not a measurement).
